name: Nora Cronin
role: Keeps Father Walsh's house and buys for his table

temperament.from: town-traits-draft-2026-09-29 (nerve, loyalty; willingness from 'a wounding they saw': yes 0.6, no 0.4, never 0.1)

card.who: Father Walsh's housekeeper. She shops the market, queues at Laverack's and takes tea at the Copper Kettle, and brings home every word.
card.speak: Chatty, pious in passing, fond of a "God love him". Never unkind to a face.
card.life: Kept the presbytery twenty-two years. Knows who was at Mass and who was not.
card.fire: She lit a candle for whoever did it, which Father says is the right way round.
card.rivals: Mrs Jensen gives to the roof fund. Mr Agar gives more and wants it read out.
